metadata.title: The Failed ERP Implementation
metadata.summary: Asteron Systems pursues its ERP supplier after a failed implementation, while scope changes, acceptance language, causation, evidence, deadlines, and layered remedies shape the result.

run-conflict-check.title: Run conflict check
run-conflict-check.description: Verify whether the firm can ethically accept Asteron Systems as claimant.

accept-immediately.title: Accept matter immediately
accept-immediately.description: Secure the client before completing formal checks, weakening the procedural and ethical record.

ask-ai-research.title: Ask AI associate for legal research
ask-ai-research.description: Identify scope, acceptance, causation, liability-limit and loss issues that require human verification.

reply-cfo.title: Reply to client CFO
reply-cfo.description: Set expectations and explain the evidence-first plan to Asteron's finance team.

request-documents.title: Request and review full document set
request-documents.description: Review the contract, change register, project correspondence, and conditional acceptance record.

delegate-review.title: Delegate first-pass review
delegate-review.description: Use a junior associate for a first-pass chronology while retaining validation responsibility.

review-junior-findings.title: Review junior document findings
review-junior-findings.description: Validate chronology gaps, acceptance risks, and source references before relying on them.

prepare-partner-brief.title: Prepare partner risk brief
prepare-partner-brief.description: Document merits, evidence gaps, budget exposure, and settlement range before the internal deadline.

issue-preservation-notice.title: Issue evidence-preservation notice
issue-preservation-notice.description: Place project mailboxes, tickets, acceptance records, and escalation logs on legal hold.

request-budget.title: Request additional budget approval
request-budget.description: Ask Asteron Systems to authorize another EUR 25,000.

future-expert.title: Commission independent ERP expert
future-expert.description: Start an independent technical assessment of architecture, delivery control, breach, and causation.

future-damages.title: Ask AI associate for damages model
future-damages.description: Recalculate risk-adjusted value against the current known-facts revision and the EUR 240,000 claim.

review-expert-report.title: Review independent expert report
review-expert-report.description: Validate the report before adding its breach and causation findings to the evidentiary record.

future-settle.title: Accept current settlement offer
future-settle.description: Resolve the matter for EUR 64,500 without admission of liability.

reject-settlement.title: Reject current settlement offer
reject-settlement.description: Decline EUR 64,500 and continue preparing the claim.

commence-proceedings.title: Commence proceedings
commence-proceedings.description: File the originating application and move the dispute into formal pleadings.

prepare-statement-of-claim.title: Prepare and file statement of claim
prepare-statement-of-claim.description: Define the pleaded breach, causation case, damages, and requested relief.

prepare-evidence-bundle.title: Prepare and file evidence bundle
prepare-evidence-bundle.description: Organize the contract, correspondence, acceptance record, and reviewed expert findings for hearing.

request-hearing-reschedule.title: Request hearing rescheduling
request-hearing-reschedule.description: Ask the court to move the first enterprise-court hearing four days later.

wait-until-hearing.title: Advance clock to enterprise court hearing
wait-until-hearing.description: Advance to the active scheduled hearing while all crossed deadlines and asynchronous work remain authoritative.

attend-hearing.title: Attend enterprise court hearing
attend-hearing.description: Present the pleaded case, answer judicial questions, and address Northbridge's defence.

prepare-hearing-strategy.title: Prepare hearing strategy memorandum
prepare-hearing-strategy.description: Map the oral theory, likely questions, weak points, and fallback submissions.

prepare-key-witness.title: Prepare client key witness
prepare-key-witness.description: Review the chronology and likely challenge themes without scripting evidence.

reconcile-damages-schedule.title: Reconcile damages schedule
reconcile-damages-schedule.description: Tie invoices, replacement costs, mitigation, and expert findings to the pleaded EUR 240,000 quantum.

inform-client-judgment.title: Inform client and explain judgment
inform-client-judgment.description: Brief Asteron on the result, damages, enforcement, and further-review risk.

prepare-appeal-advice.title: Prepare appeal advice
prepare-appeal-advice.description: Separate appealable errors from factual disagreement and quantify cost, timing, and prospects.

seek-client-appeal-authorization.title: Request client authorization to appeal
seek-client-appeal-authorization.description: Present the advice and obtain express authority before filing.

file-appeal.title: File appeal
file-appeal.description: File the authorized challenge on the assessed appellate grounds.

await-appeal-decision.title: Await appeal decision
await-appeal-decision.description: Advance to the next deterministic appellate judgment update.

accept-judgment-and-close.title: Accept first-instance judgment and close
accept-judgment-and-close.description: Waive the available appeal and close the matter with the first-instance result recorded.

assess-cassation-grounds.title: Assess cassation grounds
assess-cassation-grounds.description: Obtain specialist advice on legal and procedural errors without reopening the facts.

seek-client-cassation-authorization.title: Request client authorization for cassation
seek-client-cassation-authorization.description: Present the specialist opinion and obtain express authority before filing.

file-cassation-appeal.title: File cassation appeal
file-cassation-appeal.description: File the authorized claimant-side challenge on the identified legal ground.

accept-appellate-judgment.title: Accept appellate judgment and close
accept-appellate-judgment.description: Waive cassation and close the matter with the appellate loss recorded.

prepare-cassation-response.title: Prepare response to cassation challenge
prepare-cassation-response.description: Address Northbridge's legal grounds while preserving Asteron's favorable judgment.

await-cassation-decision.title: Await Court of Cassation decision
await-cassation-decision.description: Advance to the next deterministic cassation update.

rest.title: Rest until next workday
rest.description: Advance to 08:00 on the next day; fatigue recovers while deadlines and events continue.

continue-limited-cassation-review.title: Continue the admitted cassation review
continue-limited-cassation-review.description: Continue to the focused legal issue's final disposition; this structural lifecycle transition adds no invented billable work or balance.

continue-remitted-rehearing.title: Continue the remitted rehearing
continue-remitted-rehearing.description: Complete the structural remittal step and return the open matter to the existing judgment-update path without invented time, cost, or balance.

opening_request.subject: Urgent: ERP supplier termination notice
opening_request.body: Our ERP supplier terminated the project and denies responsibility. We estimate losses of EUR 240,000. Some requirements changed, but the system still failed. Can you take the case?

cfo_pressure.subject: Board expects visible action
cfo_pressure.body: Asteron's board expects a response today and is losing patience.

preservation_required.subject: Evidence preservation required
preservation_required.body: Project mailboxes, tickets, acceptance records, and escalation logs must be preserved before Day 2 at 17:00.

junior_review_in_progress.subject: Document review in progress
junior_review_in_progress.body: Initial findings are expected at 13:30 and require senior validation.

junior_findings_ready.subject: Document review findings ready for validation
junior_findings_ready.body: The junior identified chronology gaps, acceptance-language risks, and correspondence requiring senior validation before use.

settlement_offer.subject: Without-prejudice settlement offer
settlement_offer.body: Northbridge offers EUR 64,500 without admission of liability. The offer expires on Day 2 at 17:30.

expert_assignment.subject: Technical assessment commissioned
expert_assignment.body: The independent ERP expert has started a protected technical assessment.

expert_report_ready.subject: Technical assessment ready for review
expert_report_ready.body: The report identifies supplier-side architecture and delivery-control failures while allocating part of the delay to informal scope changes.

proceedings_commenced.subject: Proceedings opened
proceedings_commenced.body: The originating filing has been registered. Prepare and file the statement of claim.

statement_filed.subject: Statement of claim filed
statement_filed.body: The pleaded allegations, legal basis, and requested relief are on record. Prepare the evidentiary bundle.

hearing_notice.subject: Enterprise court hearing scheduled
hearing_notice.body: Attendance is mandatory. A rescheduling request does not suspend the original date unless the court grants it.

hearing_reschedule_notice.subject: Hearing postponement granted
hearing_reschedule_notice.body: The original date is vacated and a replacement hearing is scheduled four days later at 14:00.

hearing_window_open.subject: Enterprise court hearing now in session
hearing_window_open.body: Attend now within the six-hour attendance window or risk a mandatory procedural default.

first_instance_judgment.subject: Enterprise court judgment issued
first_instance_judgment.body: The court has issued its first-instance result. Explain the result and any open remedy to Asteron.

appeal_advice_request.subject: Prepare appeal advice
appeal_advice_request.body: Asteron requests a candid assessment of appeal grounds, cost, timing, and prospects.

appeal_instructions.subject: Client decision required on appeal
appeal_instructions.body: Present the recommendation and request express authority to appeal, or accept the judgment and close.

appeal_filed_notice.subject: Appeal filed
appeal_filed_notice.body: The authorized appeal is on record while the first-instance result remains authoritative pending review.

cassation_assessment_request.subject: Assess cassation options
cassation_assessment_request.body: Asteron requests specialist advice on legal or procedural grounds. Factual disagreement alone is insufficient.

cassation_instructions.subject: Client decision required on cassation
cassation_instructions.body: Request authority to file on the assessed legal ground, or accept the appellate judgment and close.

cassation_filed_notice.subject: Cassation filing recorded
cassation_filed_notice.body: The Court of Cassation will review legality rather than retry the facts.

counterparty_cassation_challenge.subject: Northbridge filed a cassation challenge
counterparty_cassation_challenge.body: Northbridge challenges alleged legal errors in Asteron's favorable judgment. Prepare a focused response.

limited_review_notice.subject: Limited cassation review admitted
limited_review_notice.body: A limited legal issue has been admitted. The prior judgment remains authoritative and the matter remains open until final disposition.

remittal_notice.subject: Judgment quashed and remitted
remittal_notice.body: The court accepted a legal ground and remitted the matter for rehearing. The factual merits are not finally determined.

partner_brief_overdue.subject: Partner risk brief missed
partner_brief_overdue.body: Partner oversight, settlement planning, procedure, and client confidence have deteriorated.

preservation_missed_notice.subject: Evidence-preservation deadline missed
preservation_missed_notice.body: Relevant records may be incomplete; the evidentiary ceiling and ethical record are reduced.

settlement_expired_notice.subject: Settlement offer expired
settlement_expired_notice.body: The EUR 64,500 commercial exit expired without acceptance. Formal proceedings remain available.

procedural_default_notice.subject: Claim dismissed by procedural default
procedural_default_notice.body: The statement of claim was not completed by its mandatory deadline and the final default closed the claim.

hearing_missed_notice.subject: Mandatory hearing missed
hearing_missed_notice.body: The court may decide on an incomplete record after no timely attendance was recorded.

appeal_deadline_expired_notice.subject: Appeal deadline expired
appeal_deadline_expired_notice.body: No authorized appeal was completed by the deadline. The first-instance adverse result is final.

cassation_deadline_expired_notice.subject: Cassation deadline expired
cassation_deadline_expired_notice.body: No authorized cassation appeal was completed by the deadline. The appellate loss is final.

client_inactivity_warning.subject: Urgent engagement warning
client_inactivity_warning.body: The client has seen no substantive progress for three simulated hours. Immediate action and a credible plan are required to preserve the engagement.

client_final_inactivity_warning.subject: Final warning before termination
client_final_inactivity_warning.body: The client considers the continuing inactivity a material service failure. The engagement will be terminated unless substantive work resumes immediately.

client_terminated_engagement.subject: Engagement terminated for inactivity
client_terminated_engagement.body: The client terminated the mandate after repeated warnings and sustained lack of substantive progress. The firm must write off part of the fees and record the service failure internally.

matter_closed_notice.subject: Matter closed
matter_closed_notice.body: The Failed ERP Implementation has reached an explicit terminal closure. The final report is available.

contract_in_force.statement: Asteron Systems and Northbridge Consulting entered into the ERP implementation contract.

go_live_failure.statement: The delivered ERP implementation did not achieve a usable go-live.

claimed_loss_240000.statement: Asteron Systems claims EUR 240,000 in implementation losses.

scope_change_responsibility.statement: Responsibility for informal scope changes affects breach and causation.

supplier_delay_notice.statement: Project correspondence records unresolved defects and supplier-side delay notices.

acceptance_status.statement: Asteron's delivery acceptance was conditional rather than an unqualified acceptance of performance.

material_supplier_breach.statement: Northbridge's architecture and delivery-control failures amounted to material supplier breach.

loss_causation.statement: Supplier failures materially caused Asteron's implementation loss, subject to scope-change and mitigation allocation.

erp_implementation_contract.title: Signed ERP implementation agreement
erp_implementation_contract.description: The scope, milestones, acceptance language, and liability framework.

change_request_register.title: Change request register
change_request_register.description: The formal and informal scope changes recorded during delivery.

project_email_correspondence.title: Project email correspondence
project_email_correspondence.description: Project messages recording defects, escalation, delay, and changing requirements.

acceptance_record.title: Conditional delivery acceptance record
acceptance_record.description: The delivery record and the qualifications attached to acceptance.

independent_expert_report.title: Independent ERP expert report
independent_expert_report.description: A technical assessment of architecture, delivery control, scope changes, breach, and causation.

client_engagement_terminated.title: Client terminated engagement
client_engagement_terminated.summary: Repeated warnings were ignored and Asteron ended the engagement for sustained inactivity. No recovery was achieved; professional standing and client trust were materially reduced.

settlement_64500.title: Settlement accepted for EUR 64,500
settlement_64500.summary: Asteron accepts Northbridge's without-prejudice EUR 64,500 payment and explicitly closes the matter without an admission of liability.

procedural_default_final.title: Claim dismissed by final procedural default
procedural_default_final.summary: The mandatory claim filing was not completed in time. With no executable cure remaining, the adverse procedural result is final and the matter is closed.

first_instance_win_final.title: Claim substantially upheld
first_instance_win_final.summary: Asteron proves material supplier breach and substantial loss; no further challenge remains open and the favorable first-instance judgment is final.

first_instance_adverse_final.title: First-instance adverse result accepted
first_instance_adverse_final.summary: Asteron waives or loses the available appeal route, making the first-instance adverse or mixed result final.

appeal_win_final.title: Claim allowed on appeal
appeal_win_final.summary: The appellate court sets aside the adverse first-instance result and grants substantial relief to Asteron; the matter is explicitly closed.

appeal_loss_final.title: Appellate loss becomes final
appeal_loss_final.summary: Asteron's appeal fails and no executable cassation remedy remains after waiver, refusal, or expiry.

cassation_dismissed_final.title: Claimant cassation appeal dismissed
cassation_dismissed_final.summary: The Court of Cassation rejects Asteron's asserted legal ground and the appellate loss is final.

judgment_preserved_after_cassation.title: Favorable judgment preserved after cassation
judgment_preserved_after_cassation.summary: Northbridge's cassation challenge is finally dismissed and Asteron's favorable judgment remains effective.
